_meta.known_unverified_why: an element the store holds with no VERIFIED-PASS rung is DROPPED from this container pack -- only its COUNT survives, in elements_known_unverified above. pom/consult.consult finds no record of it and answers unknown-control, not known-unverified, on this pack. (The default, non-container export is where such an element still travels, flagged verified: false, label/family/tag only -- there consult() answers known-unverified.)
_meta.ranking_note: find_control breaks a same-label tie on the SUM of n_verified over the element's whole ladder -- unchanged by this schema, since the full ladder now travels for every element, verified or not.
_meta.reader: pom/store.Store(state_root=<this tree>).get(<page key>) -- the same schema the machine's own store returns; pom/consult.consult is the only rule that reads it
